## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run verify` passes locally
- [ ] Tests added or updated (new site adapter → fixture + test)
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/`, `CHANGELOG.md`, and `npm run docs:sites` if adapters changed)
- [ ] Storage schema changed? → migration added + `docs/reference/storage.md` updated
- [ ] New permission? → justified in `docs/reference/permissions.md`
